checks.explanation: Newsom survived the September 2021 recall comfortably as predicted, but COVID was not "over" -- the Delta variant wave was surging in the US at that time.
US COVID-19 vaccination coverage plateaued in the roughly 65-70% range for at least one dose, close to the predicted 60-65%.
SARS-CoV-2 remains endemic in the United States years later, confirming the prediction.
The arithmetic is correct: $2,000 compounding at 8% annually for 65 years grows to approximately $297,600.
